info.title: WuKongIM JavaScript Web Golden Path Subset
info.description: A non-exhaustive Product HTTP contract for the three trusted-BFF calls used by the JavaScript Web quickstart.

post.summary: Register the quickstart user's development token
post.description: Stores the device token required by the default Gateway's exact-match CONNECT check. It does not provide a complete production credential lifecycle.

zh.summary: 登记快速开始用户的开发 Token
zh.description: 保存默认 Gateway 对该开发身份执行 CONNECT 精确匹配所需的设备 Token；它不提供完整的生产凭据生命周期。

x-codeSamples.label: Trusted backend (cURL)
x-codeSamples.source:
# Run only from the trusted backend boundary.
curl --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:5001/user/token \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"uid":"alice","token":"server-generated-development-secret","device_flag":1,"device_level":0}'

zh.label: 受信后端（cURL）
zh.source:
# 只在受信后端边界运行。
curl --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:5001/user/token \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"uid":"alice","token":"server-generated-development-secret","device_flag":1,"device_level":0}'

zh.description: Token 变更已接受

get.description: Returns configured Gateway addresses; the BFF forwards the WebSocket address required by the browser SDK.

zh.description: 返回已配置的 Gateway 地址；BFF 只转发浏览器 SDK 所需的 WebSocket 地址。

post.summary: Pull durable messages for one channel
post.description: Pulls a bounded page of committed messages after reconnect. The quickstart uses a person Channel (channel_type 1).

zh.summary: 拉取一个 Channel 的持久消息
zh.description: 重连后有界拉取已提交消息；快速开始使用个人 Channel（channel_type 1）。

x-codeSamples.label: Trusted backend (cURL)
x-codeSamples.source:
# Run only from the trusted backend boundary.
curl --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:5001/channel/messagesync \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"login_uid":"bob","channel_id":"alice","channel_type":1,"start_message_seq":0,"end_message_seq":0,"limit":100,"pull_mode":1,"include_event_meta":0,"event_summary_mode":""}'

zh.label: 受信后端（cURL）
zh.source:
# 只在受信后端边界运行。
curl --fail-with-body \
  --request POST \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:5001/channel/messagesync \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"login_uid":"bob","channel_id":"alice","channel_type":1,"start_message_seq":0,"end_message_seq":0,"limit":100,"pull_mode":1,"include_event_meta":0,"event_summary_mode":""}'

zh.description: 有界的持久消息分页
兼容错误信封

MaintenanceUnavailable.description: The cluster is behind the restore-maintenance fence; back off and observe /readyz

zh.description: 集群处于恢复维护栅栏后；请退避并观察 /readyz

UpdateTokenRequest.description: Development identity metadata accepted only from the trusted backend boundary.

zh.description: 仅从受信后端边界接收的开发身份元数据。

uid.description: Stable product identity to create or update. It must not contain @, #, or &.

zh.description: 要创建或更新的稳定业务身份；不能包含 @、# 或 &。

token.description: Development-only token in the Beta quickstart. Keep it on the trusted BFF side.

zh.description: Beta 快速开始中的仅开发 Token；只保留在受信 BFF 一侧。

device_flag.description: Client device category. The JavaScript/Web quickstart uses 1 for Web.

zh.description: 客户端设备类别；JavaScript/Web 快速开始使用 Web 值 1。

device_level.description: Device conflict level. The quickstart uses 0 for a slave device.

zh.description: 设备冲突级别；快速开始使用从设备值 0。
兼容成功状态，固定为 200。
供人阅读的兼容错误消息。
与 HTTP 对齐的错误状态。
机器可读的恢复维护类别。
当前维护详情。

tcp_addr.description: TCP client-ingress address. The browser quickstart does not use it.

zh.description: TCP 客户端接入地址；浏览器快速开始不使用它。

ws_addr.description: Plain WebSocket ingress used only when a secure address is unavailable and the page permits it.

zh.description: 仅在安全地址不可用且页面允许时使用的普通 WebSocket 入口。

wss_addr.description: TLS WebSocket ingress preferred by HTTPS browser applications when non-empty.

zh.description: 非空时由 HTTPS 浏览器应用优先使用的 TLS WebSocket 入口。

ChannelMessageSyncRequest.description: Bounded committed-message recovery request for one visible channel.

zh.description: 针对一个可见 Channel 的有界已提交消息恢复请求。

login_uid.description: Current user represented by the trusted backend; used for person-channel normalization and membership visibility.

zh.description: 受信后端代表的当前用户；用于个人 Channel 归一化和 membership 可见性。

channel_id.description: For the person-channel quickstart, use the peer UID.

zh.description: 个人 Channel 快速开始使用对端 UID。

channel_type.description: The quickstart uses 1 for a person channel.

zh.description: 快速开始使用 1 表示个人 Channel。

start_message_seq.description: Inclusive starting sequence when non-zero. With an end boundary of 0, a zero start selects the recent-page compatibility behavior.

zh.description: 非零时为包含式起点；结束边界也为 0 时，全零边界选择最近页兼容行为。

end_message_seq.description: Exclusive ending sequence when non-zero. With a start boundary of 0, a zero end leaves the recent page without an upper bound.

zh.description: 非零时为排除式结束边界；起点也为 0 时，最近页不设置上界。

limit.description: Golden-path BFF bound; the compatible runtime has a broader internal cap.

zh.description: 黄金路径 BFF 边界；兼容运行时内部上限更宽。

pull_mode.description: Direction selector: 0 pulls older messages; 1 pulls newer messages.

zh.description: 拉取方向：0 拉取更旧消息，1 拉取更新消息。

include_event_meta.description: Set to 1 to request compact event metadata when available. The golden path uses 0.

zh.description: 设为 1 时请求可用的紧凑事件元数据；黄金路径使用 0。

event_summary_mode.description: Compatibility event-summary selector. The golden path leaves it empty.

zh.description: 兼容事件摘要选择器；黄金路径保持为空。

ChannelMessageSyncResponse.description: One bounded page of committed messages in ascending sequence order.

zh.description: 按 sequence 升序排列的一页有界已提交消息。

start_message_seq.description: Starting boundary echoed from the request.

zh.description: 从请求回显的起始边界。

end_message_seq.description: Ending boundary echoed from the request.

zh.description: 从请求回显的结束边界。

more.description: 1 means another bounded page may be available; advance the cursor before requesting it.

zh.description: 1 表示可能还有下一页；再次请求前必须推进游标。

messages.description: Committed visible messages, ordered by message_seq ascending.

zh.description: 按 message_seq 升序排列的已提交可见消息。

SyncedMessage.description: One committed message projected into the compatibility response shape.

zh.description: 投影为兼容响应结构的一条已提交消息。
固定消息行为标志。

setting.description: WKProto message-setting bitset; interpret it with the shared Message Flags dictionary.

zh.description: WKProto 消息 Setting 位集合；按共享消息标志字典解释。

message_id.description: Numeric server message ID. JavaScript consumers should prefer message_idstr to avoid precision loss.

zh.description: 数值型服务端消息 ID；JavaScript 消费者应优先使用 message_idstr，避免精度损失。

message_idstr.description: Precision-safe decimal form of the server message ID; primary recovery deduplication key.

zh.description: 不会丢失精度的服务端消息 ID 十进制字符串；恢复去重的首选键。

client_msg_no.description: Client-generated message identifier used as the secondary deduplication key.

zh.description: 客户端生成的消息标识；作为次级去重键。

message_seq.description: Committed sequence within the channel; responses are ordered by this value ascending.

zh.description: 消息在 Channel 内的已提交序号；响应按此值升序排列。
消息发送者 UID。

channel_id.description: Visible channel identifier. Person-channel responses project the canonical ID back to the peer UID.

zh.description: 可见的 Channel 标识；个人 Channel 响应会把 canonical ID 投影回对端 UID。

channel_type.description: Wire Channel Type; the golden path uses 1 for a person channel.

zh.description: Wire Channel Type；黄金路径使用个人 Channel 值 1。
可选的兼容 Topic。

expire.description: Message expiration value from the compatibility response.

zh.description: 兼容响应中的消息过期值。
服务端消息时间戳。

payload.description: Go JSON encoding of the wire payload bytes.

zh.description: Wire Payload 字节的 Go JSON 编码。

MessageHeader.description: Fixed message-header flags represented as numeric 0/1 values.

zh.description: 以数值 0/1 表示的固定消息 Header 标志。
1 表示非持久消息。
1 表示请求未读/红点处理。
1 表示仅同步一次的消息。
